# Proxima agent entry point

Read docs/agents.md, then the running host's proxima://how-to resource.
Discover schemas from tools/list, resources/list, resources/templates/list,
and proxima://tools. REST-enabled hosts publish /v1/openapi.json.

Documentation index: https://aquilo-solution-s.github.io/Proxima/
Repository agent conventions: AGENTS.md
